title: Tetanus and botulism: two toxins, opposite paralysis
blurb: Animated: tetanospasmin travels retrograde to the spinal cord and blocks glycine and GABA release, causing spastic paralysis and lockjaw, while botulinum toxin blocks acetylcholine release at the neuromuscular junction, causing flaccid paralysis, and where antitoxin, wound care with vaccine, and supportive ventilation act
